generated_documents.title: TCP/IP Origin
generated_documents.content: TCP/IP originated from ARPANET and DARPA packet-switching research. TCP and IP were separated into layers so different networks could interconnect.

generated_documents.title: TCP/IP Troubleshooting
generated_documents.content: TCP/IP troubleshooting starts with physical link and NIC status, then IP address, subnet mask, gateway, route table, DNS resolution, port listening, firewall rules, packet capture, and application timeout evidence.

generated_documents.title: TCP/IP Support Workflow
generated_documents.content: If evidence is insufficient, support should ask for topology, ip route, DNS result, service port status, firewall policy, tcpdump or packet capture, and relevant application logs.
